menus.name: Dinner tasting menu

menus.name: Lunch tasting menu
menus.note: Friday and Saturday only; Hedonistic wine pairing £265; optional cheese course £15

menus.name: Chef's Table experience
menus.note: Up to two guests, at lunch or dinner; the tasting menu with extra courses beside the kitchen

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms. Tables are released in seasonal blocks at 6pm on a Wednesday: January to March 2027 opens on 2 December 2026.

bookingWindow.note: Tables are released in seasonal blocks at 6pm on a Wednesday; January to March 2027 opens on 2 December 2026.

bookingPhone: +44 141 334 6265, 11.30am to 2.30pm Tuesday to Thursday and 9.30am to 11am Friday and Saturday
cancellation: A deposit of half the menu price per guest is taken when booking and taken off the bill. Cancel by email or phone more than 72 hours ahead for a full refund; later cancellations and no-shows lose the deposit.
groups: The largest table is for six, and larger parties can't be split across tables. The whole restaurant can be hired for up to 30 guests five days a week, with a minimum spend and at least three months' notice.
dressCode: No formal dress code; smart casual is suggested.
children: Children aged 8 and over are welcome. There is no children's menu: everyone has the tasting menu.
duration: About 2½ to 3 hours for lunch and 3 to 3½ hours for dinner.
